name: Gray-Scott
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
      Gray-scott formula coupled to a diffuse-history reagent and a pair of reagents that implement the wave equation. This allows things to react to where they have existed previously as well as to a ripple-wake of previous activity. Implemented by Dan Wills.
    </description>
    <rule name="Gray-Scott" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.39
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.08
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.04
      </param>
      <param name="k">
        0.045
      </param>
      <param name="F">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_c">
        0.012
      </param>
      <param name="D_a_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="D_b_to_c">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        1e-06
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        0.0001
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="c_pow_norm">
        1
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_k">
        0.05
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_F">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_a">
        -0.01
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_b">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Da">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Db">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="a_to_wave">
        -1.3e-05
      </param>
      <param name="b_to_wave">
        0.009
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_wave">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_diffusion">
        5e-05
      </param>
      <param name="wave_damp">
        0.9985
      </param>
      <param name="wave_power">
        0.999
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_F">
        0.01
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_k">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Da">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_Db">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_b">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="wave_to_c">
        -0.0005
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="5">
delta_a = (D_a + c*c_to_Da + d*wave_to_Da) * laplacian_a - a*b*b + (F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)*(1.0f-a) + c*c_to_a + d*wave_to_a;
delta_b = (D_b  + c*c_to_Db + d*wave_to_Db) * laplacian_b + a*b*b - ((F + c_to_F*c + d*wave_to_F)+(k + c*c_to_k + d*wave_to_k))*b + c*c_to_b + d*wave_to_b;
delta_c = -c*cDamp + a*a_to_c + b*b_to_c + D_a_to_c * laplacian_a + D_b_to_c * laplacian_b + D_c * laplacian_c;
c = clamp( powr( fabs(c)/c_pow_norm + c*wave_to_c, c_pow )*c_pow_norm, 0.0f, 1.0f );
d = sign(d) * powr( fabs(d) * wave_damp, wave_power ) + a * a_to_wave + b * b_to_wave + c * c_to_wave;
delta_e = laplacian_d * wave_diffusion;
delta_d = e + delta_e;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
